Measured on the committed code-graph.json and again on a fresh normalisation in the copy: kinds {file 43, class 0, function 841, method 1066}; 210 bare-label (class) nodes typed function; all 176 inherits edges are function to function (e.g. AnalyzeCase -> FixtureCase). The walker on the same tree gives class 239. test_graph passes only because its fixture class node (test_graph.py:206-207) carries _callable_class True without _callable True, unlike the real output (the research note Measured section counts _callable 1907 = function 841 + method 1066, classes included). Proposed fix: return "class" when raw.get("_callable_class") before the _callable test, and add _callable True to the fixture class node. architecture.json is unaffected (it collapses to files).
- Observation, not a DoD breach: the graphify extraction predates graphctl.py, so the committed tools scope lacks graphctl.py (the walker graph includes it), and build/status print no staleness warning for a graphify output older than the code.
